items.name: Tin Ore
items.flavour: Grey tin ore, heavy for its size, which the Foundry buys for its bronze.

items.name: Nickel Ore
items.flavour: Greenish nickel ore, which the Foundry wants for its harder steels.

items.name: Steam Coal
items.flavour: Hard, clean-burning coal that keeps a boiler at pressure where common coal sulks.

items.name: Manganese Ore
items.flavour: Black manganese ore that marks the hands and toughens steel past the point of reason.

items.name: Fire Opal
items.flavour: An orange opal that holds a glow long after the light goes.

items.name: Cinders
items.flavour: Half-burnt coke riddled out of the ash pits, good for one more fire.

items.name: Slag Iron
items.flavour: Beads of iron picked out of the slag heaps, where the furnace let them go.

items.name: Slag Glass
items.flavour: A clear lump of glassy slag off the heaps, bottle-green and nearly flat on one face.

items.name: Burnt Tuyere
items.flavour: A bronze blast nozzle thrown out of a furnace wall, scorched but still sound in the cone.

items.name: Spoiled Casting
items.flavour: An iron casting thrown on the heap for one cold shut that nobody else would notice.

items.name: Bronze Ingot
items.flavour: Copper and tin together, a darker bar than brass and a good deal less obliging.

items.name: Nickel Steel Ingot
items.flavour: Steel with nickel in it, which shrugs off heat that would sag a common bar.

items.name: Boiler Plate
items.flavour: A rolled sheet of nickel steel, drilled for rivets and rated for more than anyone tests it at.

items.name: Manganese Steel Ingot
items.flavour: Steel so tough the file skates off it, which is the point and also the problem.

items.name: Clinker Bar
items.flavour: A long manganese steel bar for breaking the clinker that chokes a firebox grate.

items.name: Bronze Valve
items.flavour: A bronze stop valve that seats tight and opens with a quarter turn and a grunt.

items.name: Valve Key
items.flavour: A nickel steel key that fits the Foundry's square-headed valves and nobody else's.

items.name: Pressure Gauge
items.flavour: A bronze dial behind a slag-glass face, which reads what it reads whatever anyone would prefer.

items.name: Steam Injector
items.flavour: A bronze valve and a reworked tuyere cone that force water into a boiler against its own steam.

items.name: Opal Pyrometer
items.flavour: A fire opal set in a cast housing, which reads a furnace's heat by its colour.

items.name: Gauze Goggles
items.flavour: Two cups of brass wire gauze on a strap, which stop the sparks and most of the view.

items.name: Slag Wool
items.flavour: Ash-pit clinker from the cinders, blown into grey fibre by a jet of steam, fireproof and fiercely itchy.

items.name: Slag Wool Coat
items.flavour: A coat quilted thick with slag wool, which will not burn and will not let you forget it.

items.name: Smoked Lens
items.flavour: A disc of slag glass blacked over the cinders, for looking a furnace in the eye.

items.name: Furnace Goggles
items.flavour: Bronze-rimmed goggles with smoked lenses, which show a white-hot pour as a polite orange.

items.name: Slag Felt
items.flavour: Slag wool steamed and pressed into a grey felt that turns a spark and most opinions.

items.name: Studded Felt Coat
items.flavour: A long coat of slag felt, studded with slag-iron beads where the splashes land.

items.name: Bronze Eyecups
items.flavour: Two eyecups cut from the cone of a burnt tuyere, still faintly smelling of the blast.

items.name: Founder's Goggles
items.flavour: Smoked lenses in tuyere-bronze eyecups, the kind the Foundry gives its casters and seldom anyone else.
